realtime_memories.content: blender-agent-mcp: production two-part system in this repo. blender_extension/ is a Blender 4.2+ extension running a loopback TCP bridge (JSON lines, 127.0.0.1:9876, BLENDER_AGENT_PORT env override); mcp_server/ is a stdio MCP server relaying to it. Delivered: 197 bridge commands across 12 handler domains, 203 MCP tools across 13 modules, all verified. Target: macOS, Blender 5.2.0 LTS at /Applications/Blender.app.

Follow-up task delivered: an Agent Skill at skills/blender-agent-mcp/ (SKILL.md + 6 references, ~7.5k lines). references/_tool_inventory.json is GENERATED by skills/blender-agent-mcp/scripts/gen_tool_inventory.py (make skill-inventory) and is the source of truth; tests/test_skill_docs.py fails on doc drift. Regenerate after adding any tool.

Core working rule for this repo: NEVER trust memory for Blender or MCP APIs — verify live before writing code. Use `Blender --background --factory-startup --python-expr` with get_rna_type() (which raises for missing operators; hasattr on bpy.ops lies because it resolves lazily). All verified findings are recorded in docs/BLENDER_5X_API_NOTES.md; `make probe` re-checks every documented assumption and exits non-zero when one breaks.

MCP SDK 2.0 gotchas that cost time: `mcp.server.fastmcp` was REMOVED — the FastMCP-style class is `MCPServer` from mcp.server.mcpserver (with Image, Context). Tool.inputSchema was renamed to Tool.input_schema. Returning a list like [str, Image] from a tool yields TextContent + ImageContent blocks. CRITICAL: an f-string cannot be a docstring — `f"""..."""` leaves __doc__ as None and ships MCP tools with empty descriptions.

Blender 5.2 API traps found the hard way: sculpt-session operators (mask fills/filters, face sets, mesh filters) SEGFAULT under --background, so they are guarded before invoking; Brush.sculpt_tool is gone (brushes are assets via brush.asset_activate, compound names like 'Inflate/Deflate'); Action.fcurves is gone (slotted actions: action.layers[].strips[].channelbags[].fcurves); unified_paint_settings moved onto each paint mode; geonodes modifier inputs are modifier.properties.inputs[socket_identifier] and modifier.keys() segfaults; manifest permission reasons cap at 64 chars.

Tooling notes for this repo: use mcp_server/.venv/bin/python directly — `uv run` intermittently hangs on environment resolution and blows the 120s command timeout. Verification commands: `make test` (56 pytest), headless smoke via tests/headless_smoke.py (71 assertions, 6 correctly GUI-gated), `make probe`, `make build-ext`. Known open gap the user asked about: no compositing module (scene.node_tree unexposed) — would follow the same generic node API already used by shading and geonodes.
